structure_notes: The source is a silent hands-only product ritual with nine hard-cut shots and no dialogue-dependent timing.
Preserve the result-first hook, empty-product inspection, two drink-building sequences, tactile stirring and final lift-to-lens loop.
Replace the source ocean-lettered glass with the supplied transparent double-wall fish-pattern glass in every shot.
Do not reproduce source product text, blue checkerboard graphics, coloured fish, branded drink containers or source-derived frames.
Two glasses are styling instances for two drink recipes and must not be framed as retail pack quantity.

beats.visual_action: Two completed drinks sit side by side on a low dark wooden tray as focus snaps cleanly onto the glasses.
beats.visual_sync: The visual result is legible within the first second.

beats.visual_action: Two hands tilt and rotate one empty fish-pattern glass to reveal the double-wall silhouette, rim, motif and thick base.
beats.visual_sync: One quarter-turn completes before the next cut.

beats.visual_action: Metal tongs place three or four clear ice cubes into the upright glass, then add one small citrus slice.
beats.visual_sync: Each ice drop creates a short beat; the fruit is the final accent.

beats.visual_action: A plain glass pitcher pours a steady stream of clear sparkling water over the ice.
beats.visual_sync: The liquid rises visibly through the clear double wall.

beats.visual_action: The filled glass holds still while fine bubbles rise around the ice and citrus.
beats.visual_sync: The short still insert lets the fish motif and double wall read clearly.

beats.visual_action: A hand lifts away the clear drink; a second matching glass receives ice and then a steady pour of white milk.
beats.visual_sync: The removal bridges directly into the second recipe setup.

beats.visual_action: Dark coffee pours from a clear pitcher into the milk, creating a brown-white cloud before the two finished drinks appear together.
beats.visual_sync: The colour bloom resolves into the paired result.

beats.visual_action: A clear stirrer makes one or two small circles in the clear drink while the milk coffee remains still.
beats.visual_sync: The citrus follows the gentle circular motion.

beats.visual_action: One hand lifts the clear drink toward the lens until it becomes a soft foreground wipe, then the view returns to the two finished glasses.
beats.visual_sync: The final hold recreates the opening composition.
